subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime, its core protocol and CLI surface, and its operator-facing environment variables as a permanent core architecture?
rationale: The prerequisite architecture PR is still open, and code review cannot determine whether this large new core subsystem and long-lived support surface should become product policy.

options.title: Sponsor the architecture
options.body: Approve the core direction, require the Kysely boundary repair and exact-head upgrade and live proof, then continue the stacked review.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Accept only the smallest shared durable facts and defer worker, protocol, CLI, and lifecycle integrations until each owner boundary is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Do not merge implementation slices until maintainers choose a different architecture or reject durable core for this release line.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the architecture
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, require the Kysely boundary repair and exact-head upgrade and live proof, then continue the stacked review.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties him to the state database, Gateway, and protocol boundaries central to this product and architecture choice.
